nguyenvanhuy0612/appium-novawindows2-dri.backlog_summary: 160 commits since cde0513 (ahead_by at discovery: 160). Independent product (v0.1 through v1.1.27) that stayed on the PowerShell backend instead of following upstream's C# rewrite — different transport than us. Reviewed every commit subject; the large majority (~140) are either WIP noise ('update'/'temp'/'add'/'move' with no semantic content) or PowerShell-transport-specific hardening (session protocol, thread affinity, DPI/PS-wrapper handling, ffmpeg packaging, Win32Helper.dll build) that doesn't map onto our C# server. Backend-agnostic logic (xpath, actions, window-attach, scroll) was checked individually below.

needs_porting.note: convertAbsoluteXPathToRelativeFromElement + includeContextElementInSearch — xpath convenience capability, no equivalent found in our lib/xpath or lib/commands

releaseModifierKeys capability — auto-releases stuck shift/ctrl/alt/meta after setValue; we only release modifiers on an explicit /actions/release call (lib/commands/actions.ts releaseActions), not automatically after setValue

already_ported_or_equivalent.note: tick-synchronise W3C performActions so modifier chords hold — our actions.ts already runs a per-tick loop with Promise.all across all sequences in parallel
xpath OR-in-predicate, floor/ceiling/round W3C coercion, predicate ordering fixes — our xpath/core.ts and xpath/functions.ts already implement these correctly
//Tag[n] per-parent vs global index bug — our processExprNodeAsPredicate computes positions scoped to each step's node-set already; no equivalent global-index bug pattern found
window-attach: prioritize newer processes, map handles to PIDs — our waitForNewWindow already does recursive child-PID tracking across the process tree

not_applicable.reason: PowerShell-transport-specific (session protocol overhaul, thread affinity, DPI/PS-wrapper hardening, ffmpeg-static packaging, Win32Helper.dll prebuilt shipping) or WIP/noise commits ('update', 'temp', 'add', 'move', 'restore') with no reviewable semantic content distinct from a later named commit.
